request_alias_semantics: Documented request aliases/version labels are accepted exactly. A moving request alias never proves the actual response revision. D086/D087 observed jev-latest resolve to1.14 despite the captured docs describing1.13; retain the actual response label.
unknown_model_policy: Reject unknown labels, future dates, prefixes and inferred alias equivalence. A new label requires explicit reviewed registry change and new source bindings; never infer acceptance from matching a family prefix.
provider_alias_semantics: typesafe-ai/jev is a historically observed generic provider label. Acceptance for existing token-mode accounting does not identify a dated revision; version remains null.
settlement_semantics: A registered label is necessary but not sufficient: native budget still verifies plain token mode, multiplier1, zero credits, paid input equal to usage, exact hosted destination, known HTTP success, no retries and reservation bounds.
